Cutting cloud and server costs

Your monthly hosting and cloud bill goes down without loss of quality, and the savings show in the report. Qilich builds the MVP in 1–3 weeks, from UZS 18 mln; the full version in 4–8 weeks.

Questions

What does “Cutting cloud and server costs” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $1,500–3,500 (UZS 18–42.5 mln) and the full version $4,000–10,000 (UZS 48–121 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Cutting cloud and server costs” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 1–3 weeks and the full version in 4–8 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Cutting cloud and server costs”?
Access to servers and accounts, a description of the current system, a technical contact.

Prefer to talk? Call +998 97 270 70 07 or send Qilich an enquiry.
